source_text.gate: REVIEWER CODE gate for REQ-517 slice 2a at commit 781a3dfe6. Read-only; no mix run.

task.description: Idiom, supervision, scope-creep and decision-record gate for REQ-517 2a. No edits to lib/ or test/.

result.summary: PASS with four small required cleanups (R1-R4, ELIXIR-DEV, same PR, none changes a tested behaviour except R4 which adds a lock) and advisories. IDIOM: plain Ecto/Plug context modules, no process added (correct per 0045/REQ-045: InstanceSupervisor stays empty). Transactions are Repo.transaction + Repo.rollback value returns; refusal events written after rollback in their own transaction (record_self_grant_refused/3 never raises, constant log line). Lock order A, R(TA only), N share in create; A then R in delete; A, user row FOR UPDATE in ServicePrincipal; retire does S then N then references_node? (F2 correct, plain fetch first only to keep the already-retired path unlocked, re-checks retired_at after the lock): consistent with design 3.5, no N-then-A path. Single writer holds: all role_scope_grants writes are in RoleScopeGrants (insert via changeset, delete_all), ScopedGrants never touches the table; mix task allowlist = writer module, backfill.ex (exists), schema, the task itself; wired in mix.exs @check_static_steps before format. SCOPE: no 2b component present (no route classes, no on handling, no Authorize enforcement, no shadow counters or flush GenServer, no attachment-link audit); authorization.ex adds only policy keys + required_permission clause over the existing :UsersGroupsRolesManage (no new permission atom). Modules: ScopedGrants 569 lines (parse, 3 writers, list/cursor, refusal audit; acceptable, cohesive), ServicePrincipal 156, router 181, mix task 156, RoleScopeGrants +295 (654 total, ok). Routers.Identity is now 1299 lines (+103) and Identity facade 3799 lines (+157): size trend worth watching, see advisories. ERROR RENDERING: matches pinned inventory 3.2: 422 invalid_body/invalid_role/invalid_principal/no_binding/invalid_scope_node, 409 grant_exists/tenant_wide_row_exists/self_grant_refused/last_scoped_row/last_admin_binding_row/last_tenant_wide_admin, 404 not_found (uncastable id included), 400 invalid limit/invalid cursor, catch-all 500 detail-free (INV-8); service-principal uniform 403, 422 invalid_body before reason checks, reason_required/invalid_reason, 404 after reason. MIGRATIONS: both guarded by if prefix(), both registered in the tenant manifest with matching versions and file names, FK down is guarded by to_regclass and drops IF EXISTS, flag column is NOT NULL DEFAULT false with reversible change/0, precheck is frozen SQL with count-only message and lock A first. migration_test change is strengthened, not weakened (FK rolled back first, dangling-grant precheck assertion, FK re-added); the assert_raise RuntimeError on Ecto.Migrator is unverified (tests not run). DESIGN DEVIATIONS: (1) actor.credential: accepted (SEC D-3 asked for it) but the design 3.4 actor type and audit text must be updated (doc drift). (2) effective?/4 with its own queries: acceptable to avoid a RoleScopeGrants->Identity edge, but it duplicates Identity.group_bound_to_platform_role?/3 and leaves user_holds_role_through_group?/3 dead (R1). (3) cursor encode/decode inside ScopedGrants.list/4 instead of the router: accepted, Identity facade already builds Pagination cursors the same way (identity.ex:2169, 3474) and the repurposed-expiry-slot comment matches; the int/string arguments to build_raw_cursor_timestamp_key/4 deviate from its @spec exactly like the existing callers. (4) AC 9 token limitation: acceptable; a token principal is its owner user id and grant principals are only user|group, so owner-self and member-group refusal covers it. TYPE-SAFETY (does not block): FINDING candidate tagged type-safety: ScopedGrants.parse_create/parse_make_tenant_wide return bare map() whose shape (principal_type atom, uuid string, role string) is only enforced by the destructuring in create/3 and make_tenant_wide/3, and actor.credential is a free String.t() (audit-visible values 'oidc'|'api_token'|nil) instead of :oidc | :api_token | nil converted at the audit edge; a typed @type create_attrs and a credential atom type would make a wrong shape unrepresentable. ORCH to file under docs/issues/ and as a FINDING per WORK_BOARD section 7 (this reviewer is read-only and did not create the file). REQUIRED: R1 remove dead Identity.user_holds_role_through_group?/3 (lib/letflow/identity.ex:1384 plus its @doc/@spec) or make RoleScopeGrants.effective?(:user,...) call it; it has no caller. R2 de-duplicate credential_name/1 + grant actor map: lib/letflow/routers/identity.ex:733-746 and lib/letflow/routers/tenant_role_scope_grants.ex:62-75 are identical copies (one shared builder, e.g. in a small Letflow.Api helper); also same_id?/2 at lib/letflow/identity/scoped_grants.ex:413 duplicates same_user_id?/2 at lib/letflow/identity.ex:912 (acceptable to leave if Identity keeps it private, but prefer one). R3 lib/letflow/identity/scoped_grants.ex:434 run/3 takes an unused _actor argument; drop it and update the 3 call sites. R4 lib/letflow/identity/scoped_grants.ex:240 make_tenant_wide/3 calls only Identity.lock_tenant_admins!/1; design 3.3 step 4 takes lock R for role TENANT_ADMIN on both create and make-tenant-wide: use lock_writers!(role, prefix) there (harmless today because lock A serialises binding writers, but it is a stated deviation not listed in the dev handoff). ADVISORIES (non-blocking): the FK migration up (priv/repo/migrations/20261018100001_add_scope_node_fkey_to_role_scope_grants.exs) is not re-runnable by itself (ADD CONSTRAINT without an existence guard; Ecto version tracking prevents a double run, but a DO block with IF NOT EXISTS would match the down's guard); the service-principal handler (~60 lines) could live in a tiny router or ServicePrincipal-facing module rather than the 1299-line Routers.Identity; ScopedGrants.create/delete are 30-38 lines with nested conditionals, still readable. TESTS THAT WILL BREAK OR NEED EDITS (for TEST-DESIGNER): test/letflow/api/scope_grants_route_walk_test.exs T-RW1b (public function list of RoleScopeGrants), T-RW1c (scope_node_id and tenant_wide false now legal), new T-RW2c; test/letflow/api/authorization_enforcement_test.exs (register Letflow.Routers.TenantRoleScopeGrants in @routers, mount '/tenant/role-scope-grants'); test/letflow/api/permission_matrix_test.exs (re-run; dev needed --baseline-ref HEAD~1 for the --check task); test/letflow/routers/tenant_scope_enforcement_test.exs and tenant_auditor_routes_test.exs (token-preconditions 'information' now has service_principal_owner, token.listed count/token_ids include flagged-owner tokens, findings/1 has a 4th key); any test asserting Identity.list_tokens/1 or get-token item shape by exact map equality (owner_flagged key; test/letflow/identity_test.exs, test/letflow/routers/gh2552_token_issuer_test.exs); tests that add the TENANT_ADMIN caller to a group via POST /groups/:id/members (now 409 self_grant_refused; test/letflow/routers/identity*, test/letflow/identity*); tests pinning the tenant migration manifest count or last entry (test/letflow/support/tenant_fixture_test.exs, test/letflow/migrations/backfill_exam_tenant_modules_test.exs, test/letflow/entities/managed_types/stamp_*_test.exs reference 20261016120001); test/letflow/scope_node_paths/write_test.exs and consistency_check_test.exs only if a grant names the retired node; test/letflow/scope_node_paths/migration_test.exs already edited, must be run (assert_raise RuntimeError is unverified); a new test for the mix task (scan/1 and audit/2 are public) with the verbatim must-pass fixtures. Do not write tests for the dead user_holds_role_through_group?/3 (R1).
